description: HomeFragment.kt is a Kotlin source file for an Android TV application. It defines the HomeFragment class, which composes and manages the main home screen UI including hero carousel, focus navigation, and data loading via ViewModel.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing the home screen UI, including hero carousel, focus navigation, and data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes repository and ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs and initializes the View hierarchy, sets up UI sections, focus navigation, and initial focus requests.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets focus to the ComposeView and starts observing ViewModel data.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Ensures navigation regains focus and starts hero auto-scroll.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops hero auto-scroll and cancels ongoing animations.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData from ViewModel to update UI states.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching rail.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching rail.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV channels rail.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV channels rail.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message with retry option on load failure.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates Continue Watching rail with fetched data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV Channels rail with fetched data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Creates and adds a Compose-based top navigation bar.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures the hero banner carousel, including auto-scroll, focus, and peeking behavior.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel on a specified card index with smooth scrolling.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling when user interacts via D-pad.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Begins automatic hero carousel scrolling every 3 seconds.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops auto-scrolling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates and adds Continue Watching section UI.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates and adds TV Channels section UI.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus for content rails.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels (px).
